title: No Endermen Cheesing
description: Endermen will teleport nearby players that can't be reached
body:
With this mod, endermen are a dangerous mob once again.

Angered endermen will teleport you to them if they cannot reach you (with customizable restrictions).

This prevents common cheesing tactics, such as hiding under two-block high ceilings.


<details>
<summary>Config Summary</summary>
  
Configs are found in the `no_endermen_cheesing` folder inside the main config folder.

distance
---
Defines how far in blocks an endermen can teleport you.

If more blocks are between you and an endermen, then it cannot teleport you.

_This value must be a number greater than zero._

interval
---
Defines how long in seconds an endermen must wait before it can teleporting you.

If less time has passed since an endermen was angered or teleported you, then it cannot teleport you yet.

_This value must be a number greater than or equal to zero._

</details>
